A Bloomberg excerpt indexed by Techmeme describes weaker Anthropic trading after its debut, but its headline refers to after-hours activity while the excerpt refers to a second trading day. The supplied URL is the publication homepage and was inaccessible.

The precise observation time and the offering-total definition could not be checked. The reported total should not be conflated with another report’s public share-sale proceeds or concurrent private placement without a reconciliation. No current quotation or causal explanation of the price move is established.
highlights: Headline and excerpt refer to different trading windows
Supplied link is not article specific
Offering totals may use different scope
No live price or single cause is verified
